author: Dicadelmi
content: Thanks to Dancing Cubs for the excellent service I received when booking the toddlers soft play ground. They arrived well before the party and magically transformed an open space into a kids dream playground. The kiddies had an absolute ball playing on the playground and the mom's were in heaven cause they could sit back and relax for a while. I think it's safe to say that the playground was the highlight of Simon's party. And the best part is it was really affordable. Thanks again Zara and all your team, we will be back for the next party. We high recommend Dancing Cubs to all mom's and dad's planning parties!
